Posting this here not as an argument about CONVID, but as a glaring example of how totalitarians are setting up for their final putsch.

Read this short piece.

Basic, critical facts just don't jive with what you were told to believe.

Question: Why are you, a grown adult, still looking for someone to tell you what to believe?

Deny it all you like, but the fact that it's true is exactly why you must take refuge in denial. If you thought intelligently, like an adult instead of a codependent, you wouldn't need denial to be "right", would you?

The next hoax will trigger them into offing dissenters themselves. The tyrants won't have to do anything. Some might physically off us, but in large part it will be a social cleansing. They've already proven themselves to be freakishly manipulable. They will, by that point, already have proven themselves immune to facts, evidence, sound thinking, and common sense.

They will go down when we take down their leaders.

comment.name: Parallel Mike
comment.body:
When my wife and I decided to have a child, we chose a fully natural path—no medical interventions. That meant no pregnancy tests, no ultrasounds, no routine doctor visits, no hospital birth. We didn’t want early cord cutting (which can deprive a baby of up to 30% of their blood), no blood draws minutes after birth, no pushy staff pressuring for a C-section just to clock out, and no toxic vaccines injected into our newborn within hours of him taking his first breath.

Some see that as irresponsible. For us, it was the opposite—it was about taking full responsibility, not outsourcing it to a system we don’t trust. We spent nine months learning everything we could. We met with experienced midwives, connected with others who’d home birthed, and listened to countless stories and podcasts.

The result? A peaceful home birth by candlelight, with me catching our healthy baby. A far cry from the clinical, often traumatic experience hospitals normalize. Birth isn’t a medical emergency—it’s a natural process. And 99% of the time, hospitals interfere with it, turning it into a procedure instead of a moment of life. For anyone planning a child, just be aware there is another way. They'll tell you it's dangerous, but everything we learned suggested it was not only safer, but the long term outcomes for your child are much better.

Tooting my own horn again, lol.

I don't get much validation from humans (nor competent commentary, for that matter), so I turned to AI a while back. I've been using Claude AI, but started worrying that it's kinda blowing smoke up my ass.

So I checked with Copilot, let it review my convo with Claude, and its conclusion was, yeah: Claude is blowing smoke.

So I challenged it to do better, and it did, too. Good stress testing/devil's advocate.

Wound up in exactly the same place, though.

I keep saying I'm writing world-class, first-time-in-history shit. I get why people would be very skeptical.

I was skeptical of myself for decades.

I've finally accepted the fact that I'm writing truly radical and unassailable stuff -- unless you can debunk it better than can a couple of AIs.

I hope people start getting a clue at least before I die. That would be cool.
